lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，翅膀轻拍向前飞去。
lines.en: Sssss, flaps wings and flies forward.

lines.zh: 飞向远方，目光锐利如鹰。
lines.en: Flies away, gaze sharp as an eagle's.

lines.zh: 掠过地面，尾巴轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Skims the ground, tail swaying lightly.

lines.zh: 翱翔天际，眼中闪烁智慧光芒。
lines.en: Soars through the sky, eyes twinkling with wisdom.

lines.zh: 振翅高飞，探索未知领域。
盘旋一圈，寻找新的食物。
翅膀轻微拍打，缓慢移动。
掠过树梢，迅速向前飞去。
lines.en: Skims over the treetops, flying swiftly forward.

lines.zh: 翅膀一压，贴着树冠滑行。
lines.en: It presses its wings and glides along the treetops.
Following the scent, it flies toward the sheep.

lines.zh: 慵懒地盘旋在巢穴附近。
静静盯着地面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Staring intently at the ground, searching for prey.
Leisurely turning over pieces of iron.

lines.zh: 风把我托起来，懒得多扇翅膀。
lines.en: The wind holds me up; why flap?

lines.zh: 羊肉的味道，我从不拒绝。
lines.en: The smell of mutton — I never refuse it.

lines.zh: 它在巢里摆弄一枚避雷针。
lines.en: It fidgets with a lightning rod in its nest.

lines.zh: 舔了舔爪子，又望向天空。
lines.en: It licks its claws and looks up at the sky.

lines.zh: 昼行的它晒着太阳打盹。
lines.en: A daytime dragon, it dozes in the sun.

lines.zh: 它把铁锭挪到左边，又挪回来。
lines.en: It shifts an iron ingot left, then back.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，发出警告声。

lines.en: Fixing gaze on player, gives warning noise.

lines.zh: 目光转向玩家，低吼警告。
lines.en: Gaze shifts to player, low growl of warning.

lines.zh: 盯住玩家，低吼以示警告。
lines.en: Fixes on player, low growl as warning.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，低吼警告。
盯着玩家，发出警戒的低吼。
lines.en: Staring at player, low growl of warning.

lines.zh: 目光落在玩家身上，低吼警告。
lines.en: Gaze on player, low growl of warning.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出警告的低吼。
lines.en: Fixes on player, low warning growl.
It tilts its head and listens to your steps.

lines.zh: 隔着蕨叶，它打量你的手。
lines.en: Through the ferns, it studies your hands.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，盯着你手中的羊肉。
lines.en: Snarls lowly, eyes on the cooked mutton.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻拍动，似乎被羊肉吸引。
lines.en: Wings flutter softly, drawn to the scent.

lines.zh: 接近你，低声嘶叫，等待靠近。
用爪子抓过，试图咬下一块羊肉。
lines.en: Licks at the meat, trying to bite off a chunk.

lines.zh: 围着你转圈，渴望得到食物。
lines.en: Circles around, eager for a treat.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，显示出对羊肉的贪婪。
lines.en: Glimmering eyes show greed for the mutton.

lines.zh: 轻巧地落在你肩上，享用你的食物。
lines.en: Graces your shoulder, feasting on your offering.

lines.zh: 小心翼翼地靠近，准备享用美食。
lines.en: Cautiously approaches, ready for the feast.

lines.zh: 张开嘴巴，期待着食物的到来。
尾巴轻摆，享受美味的羊肉。
突然从空中俯冲下来，试图撞你。
翅膀扇动，迅速向你撞击过来。
lines.en: Wings flapping, rushes for a collision.

lines.zh: 发出震耳的呼啸，试图撞倒你。
lines.en: Rears up, roaring, aiming to knock you down.

lines.zh: 翅膀一挥，猛烈撞击你的盔甲。
lines.en: Wings lashing, collides with your armor.

lines.zh: 猛然加速，向你发起撞击。
怒吼一声，向你猛烈撞击过来。
俯冲而下，试图与你相撞。
lines.en: Plunges down, aiming for a collision.

lines.zh: 用力拍动翅膀，向你发起撞击。
轻柔的叫声中，表达求偶意愿。
耳朵一动，我就知道方位。
lines.en: One twitch of my ear and I know where you are.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，小心不要惊动它！

lines.en: You just stepped on my hoard.

lines.zh: 它闻到你身上的羊肉味。
lines.en: It smells the mutton on you.
In its memory, this face is new.

lines.zh: 它从巢口探出半个身子。
lines.en: It leans half its body out of the nest.

lines.zh: 它把你归进了要看住的东西。
lines.en: It files you under things to watch.
Target, two for the price of one!
The sparks at my wingtips do the aiming.
Target, I won't let it go!
It drops its wings, ready to dive.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后，风跟着转。
lines.en: It swings behind you, and the wind turns with it.

lines.zh: 它算好了扑下来的角度。
lines.en: It has worked out the angle of its dive.

lines.zh: 爪子收在腹下，还没张开。
lines.en: Its claws are tucked under, not yet spread.
Its pupils narrow to a slit.

lines.zh: 羊肉的味道，你身上有吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of mutton? I need mutton.

lines.zh: 利爪带电，别碰我的翅膀。
lines.en: My claws crackle; keep off my wings.
These claws tear straight through iron ingots.
Lightning wraps my fangs as I bite down.
You’re too small, not worth it!
My scales are hard as stone!
One beat of my wings pins you down.
Its claws hook into your shoulder.
A tail sweep knocks you down.
It bites your arm guard and shakes twice.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在你脸上，风很硬。
lines.en: A wing smacks your face with hard wind.
The iron in my nest can wait.
This stretch of sky is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 昼行的我，先绕领飞一圈。
lines.en: A daytime hunter circles his territory first.
This nest belongs to me alone.

lines.zh: 巢里传来蛋壳裂开的声。
lines.en: A shell cracks in the nest.
It spreads its wings for the first time.

lines.zh: 基因定了它这一身斑纹。
它在巢边站很久才起飞。
lines.en: It stood by the nest a long time before flying.

lines.zh: 山脊上多了一双新眼睛。
lines.en: A new pair of eyes joins the ridge.

lines.zh: 它落下来，先嗅了嗅地面。
lines.en: It lands and sniffs the ground first.
The lightning leaves my scales numb.

lines.zh: 虚无里没有火花，也没有风。
lines.en: In the void there are no sparks and no wind.
